children.label: qualitative_methods
children.description: Methodologies that focus on understanding the experiences, perceptions, and contexts of individuals and communities through in-depth interviews, focus groups, and ethnographic research.
example_papers: Mid-term evaluation of the project "Upscaling climate resilience measures in the Dry Corridor agroecosystems of El Salvador (RECLIMA)"

children.label: quantitative_methods
children.description: Methodologies that involve the collection and analysis of numerical data to measure the impact, effectiveness, and efficiency of humanitarian interventions using statistical techniques and surveys.

children.label: mixed-methods
children.description: Methodologies that combine both qualitative and quantitative approaches to provide a more comprehensive understanding of humanitarian evaluation, integrating data from multiple sources and methods.

children.label: participatory_methods
children.description: Methodologies that involve active participation and collaboration with affected communities in the evaluation process, ensuring that their voices and perspectives are central to the assessment and decision-making.

children.label: systems_thinking_methods
children.description: Methodologies that apply systems thinking principles to evaluate the complex and interconnected nature of humanitarian contexts, focusing on the relationships and dynamics between different elements of the system.
